tools.name: find_creator
tools.description: Find creators on lookmybio by username or name. Returns their bio page links. Use it when someone asks for a creator’s link in bio, website or socials and you do not know their exact lookmybio username.

tools.name: get_bio_page
tools.description: Read a creator’s lookmybio bio page: name, bio, links and the blocks on the page, exactly as visitors see it. Link people to the page URL.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List the published posts on a creator’s lookmybio blog, newest first, with links. Use get_blog_post to read one.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Read one post from a creator’s lookmybio blog as plain text, by its slug (the last part of the post URL).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_bio_page, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_bio_page, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
